items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: told Stock, I said don't tell anybody, what difference is it going to make

ctx.x: And so Stock, what's the matter now, what's the smell, somethings going on in there, and so he knocked on my door and he didn't know exactly who it was and he goes and finds out exactly who was in the room. So he came back and said, Fields, I know it's you, open up, I smell you pressing in there, I smell that wool. So I opened the door and I

told Stock, I said don't tell anybody, what difference is it going to make, I'm trying to look a little decent for this parade and he goes anybody ought to know, you're an electrician and you're in here pressing in your room. You might set the building on fire, you got no business. So he turned me in and so they called me up to the office and they said what in the world, you're an electrician and you're in there pressing, I suspect you're the one who helped fix up the place with the proper wiring. He said well,…
Now when they suspended you, they would send you home?
